front.label: Front
front.desc: Your name, laser etched. Nothing is printed, so nothing can fade.

front.label: NFC chip
front.desc: Tap a phone to the card to read it. It needs no battery.

front.label: Namehash mark
front.desc: The Hyperliquid mark is data. Each glyph is the next character of your name's hash, read left to right and top to bottom.

front.label: Your name
front.desc: The name you enter, laser etched into the metal. It resolves to your wallet onchain.

front.label: Signed line
front.desc: Your name, card number and the HYPE token id, repeated across the waist of the mark.

front.label: Partner mark
front.desc: Hyperliquid India and ENS, the two parties behind the card.

front.label: Card number
front.desc: Your number out of 25. It is set when your card is confirmed.

back.label: Back
back.desc: The proof face. A seal to tap, a mark only your name makes, and the record of where it all started.

back.label: Seal
back.desc: Tap or scan to open this name's record. The ring around it is the HYPE genesis record: date, unix time, wallets, distribution.

back.label: Hash mark
back.desc: 256 cells, one for each bit of your name's namehash. No two names share this mark.

back.label: Name spine
back.desc: Your name runs up the right edge, like a title on a book.

back.label: Timeline
back.desc: Twenty four ticks from HYPE genesis to House of HYPE in Mumbai, one a month.

back.label: Partner mark
back.desc: Hyperliquid India and ENS, the two parties behind the card.

back.label: Card number
back.desc: Your number out of 25. It is set when your card is confirmed.
